title: Local SEO Setup
description: Configure local business visibility for service-area and brick-and-mortar WordPress sites.

steps.title: Standardize NAP Data
steps.instructions: Ensure business Name, Address, and Phone match exactly across the site footer, contact page, and Google Business Profile.

steps.title: Add LocalBusiness Schema
steps.instructions: Configure LocalBusiness schema with address, geo coordinates, opening hours, and price range where applicable.

steps.title: Create Location / Service Area Pages
steps.instructions: Build unique location or service-area landing pages with local content — avoid duplicate city swap templates.

steps.title: Claim Google Business Profile
steps.instructions: Verify the listing, add categories, photos, services, and link the website URL with UTM parameters if tracking locally.

steps.title: Embed Map on Contact Page
steps.instructions: Add an embedded Google Map or static map image on the contact page with correct pin placement.

steps.title: Audit Top Citations
steps.instructions: List the business on key directories (Yelp, Bing Places, Apple Maps, industry-specific sites) with consistent NAP.
